context: Two friends gossip about a mutual acquaintance — relationship news
purpose: Teach: 恋人/離婚/移転/あちこち/おれ/勿論/ご存知/つくり

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、田中さんが離婚したって知ってる?ご存知の通り、あの夫婦ラブラブだったのに。
lines.en: Hey, did you know Tanaka got divorced? As you know, that couple used to be all lovey-dovey.
lines.style: Teen opener leaning in with hot gossip, casual 知ってる then a playful ご存知の通り for ironic effect

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっ、まじで?おれは全然知らなかったわ、そんな話。
lines.en: Huh, seriously? I had absolutely no idea about that.
lines.style: University guy genuinely surprised, casual masculine おれ self-reference, voice rising in disbelief

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: もう新しい恋人もいるらしいよ、しかも同じ会社の人なんだって。
lines.en: Apparently she's already got a new partner too, and supposedly someone from the same company.
lines.style: Teen dishing juicy follow-up gossip with a knowing, slightly scandalized tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、勿論おれは初耳だけど、そういうの広まるの早いよな。
lines.en: Huh, of course this is the first I'm hearing of it, but stuff like that spreads fast, huh.
lines.style: University student using bookish kanji 勿論 ironically while admitting he was totally out of the loop

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あちこちで噂になってるみたい。SNSでもめっちゃ広がってるよ。
lines.en: Seems like the rumor's going around everywhere. It's spreading like crazy on social media too.
lines.style: Teen emphasizing how widespread the gossip is, casual intensifier めっちゃ for teen energy

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい家のつくりまで自分でこだわって決めたらしいぞ、おしゃれな感じで。
lines.en: I heard she even fussed over the layout of her new place herself, going for a stylish vibe.
lines.style: University guy adding his own intel about her new home, ending with masculine sentence particle ぞ

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 引っ越しが会社の移転と同じタイミングだったから、けっこう計画的だったのかもね。
lines.en: Her move happened right when the company relocated, so maybe it was all pretty planned out.
lines.style: Teen speculating thoughtfully, connecting her move to the company's relocation with detective-like curiosity

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 怖っ。おれだったら絶対バレてるぞ、そんな大胆なこと。
lines.en: Scary. If it were me, I'd definitely get caught pulling something that bold.
lines.style: University student joking self-deprecatingly, short reactive 怖っ then masculine ぞ for register consistency
